# PCW Renew48 Blocks

This is a WordPress Gutenberg plugin for public, non-PHI marketing pages across Renew48, ChiroGoAZ, and AromaHMT.

## Agent rules

- Use a Renew48 pattern before generating bespoke markup.
- Preserve existing page status; new campaign pages default to review/draft until approved.
- Keep medical intake, appointment details, patient data, and membership records outside WordPress.
- Direct booking to the approved provider system and commerce checkout to WooCommerce.
- For all `insurance-packages-draft` uses, retain draft status until business, payer, and compliance approval is recorded.

## Discoverable page patterns

Use `renew48/chiropractic-services`, `renew48/massage-services`, `renew48/service-detail-flow`, `renew48/committed-wellness`, `renew48/referral-program`, and the named campaign patterns registered in `PCW_Renew48_Blocks::register_patterns`.

## Block contract

Every registered `renew48/*` block accepts public copy (`title`, `eyebrow`, `body`), CTA (`ctaLabel`, `ctaUrl`), presentation (`theme`, `variant`, `mediaUrl`, `mediaAlt`, `interaction`), and optional item arrays. Layout blocks also preserve nested Gutenberg blocks through InnerBlocks.
